AstraFlow Flagship Portal Architecture

Long image

A

Answer

AstraFlow will launch with a hybrid Next.js 15 App Router architecture uniting an award-winning museum-grade landing page, an interactive C# WASM playground, an MDX docs engine, and native embedded Archify/Understand visualizers.

  1. Next.js 15 App Router with static generation ensures sub-second edge loading worldwide.
  2. Interactive C# WebAssembly simulation lets developers test Mediator pipelines and Mapper rules without leaving the browser.
  3. Native Archify and Understand Anything view modes provide deep visual architecture exploration for architects and contributors.
  4. Automated CI changelog synchronization guarantees the web changelog updates atomically on every release.

Applies toAstraFlow OSSLanding Page & Docs PortalNext.js 15

Implementation phases and gates

  1. Design System & Token Architecture ↗

    Establish Obsidian & Cyan orbital palette, typography scale, and layout tokens.

  2. Hero & Landing Page Showcase ↗

    Build the hero section, benchmark sliders, interactive comparisons, and features grid.

  3. Interactive Pipeline Playground ↗

    Implement in-browser Mediator and Mapper simulation with Monaco and live code diffs.

  4. Comprehensive Docs Portal ↗

    Structure guides, API references, scenarios, and migration cookbooks with instant search.

  5. Archify & Understand Hub ↗

    Embed standalone interactive architecture diagrams and knowledge tours.

  6. Changelog & Automated CI Sync ↗

    Connect GitHub releases to automated web changelog rendering.
